content: Base UI palette pattern: official docs present Combobox (input + filtered list) composed with Dialog as the command-palette architecture; @base-ui/react latest 1.8.0 (project has 1.7.0 installed, sufficient). Project already wraps Dialog, Combobox (Root/Collection/Group/GroupLabel/Empty) and runs Combobox-inside-Dialog in production (employee-dialog.tsx, movement-dialogs.tsx) with UAT-proven items-on-Root contract.
